}}'''Elin Warrel''' is an [[Andoran]] [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Brown Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Elin Warrel}}

== Appearance ==
Elin is slender. She is not tall, but still taller than [[Moiraine Damodred]].{{ref/book|0|2}} Being raised to the shawl very recently Elin still has to gain the ageless look of an Aes Sedai.

== Strength ==
Comparing Elin's years of training to that of other Aes Sedai, she must be very weak in the One Power. The Companion does not list her strength, but it can be guessed that her level of strength is between the levels {{opsl|44}} and {{opsl|51}} (the weakest known Aes Sedai).

==History==
Elin is 47 years old. She was born in the year [[953 NE]] in [[Andor]] and she went to the [[White Tower]] in [[971 NE]]. After spending fifteen years as [[novice]] and fourteen as [[Accepted]] she was raised to the shawl in the year [[1000 NE]].

Elin was a novice of twenty-five when [[Gitara Moroso]] had her [[Foretelling]] about the [[Dragon]] being reborn. During that event Elin was in the anteroom of the [[Amyrlin Seat|Amyrlin]]'s apartment, so she was not able to hear the words pronounced by Gitara. At that time she had been a novice for seven years while [[Moiraine]] and [[Siuan Sanche]] were able to gain the shawl after only three years as novices and three as Accepted.{{ref/book|0|2}}

==Activities==
[[Elayne Trakand]] mentions that Elin was the oldest Accepted when she arrived in the [[White Tower]]. [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] thought that they are the same age, but later she discovered that Elin's younger sister is about forty when she came to the Tower to visit her. So Elayne and Nynaeve guessed that Elin had been in the Tower for a very long time since she started as a novice. She has [[Slowing|slowed]] in her ageing, because of using the [[One Power]] for so long, but still she has not gained the ageless look of an Aes Sedai. The case of Elin confronted also to that of [[Aiel]] [[Wise Ones]] and the [[Kinswomen]] allowed Nynaeve and Elayne to theorize correctly that the [[Oath Rod]] is the cause of the ageless look and not a prolonged use of the One Power.

Sometime during the course of the series, Elin took and passed the test for Aes Sedai and she is now an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah; so in total she has spent roughly twenty nine years as novice and Accepted, when a medium time for an average Aes Sedai preparation is around fifteen years. So many years learning the weaves indicates that probably Elin is not very strong in ''[[saidar]]'', maybe around the level of [[Daigian Moseneillin]], who stands on the lowest level allowed to become Aes Sedai, spending a longer time as novice and Accepted than anyone in memory.

Elin has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.
